newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Solvay signs deal with Fujisawa.
newsitem.headline: Solvay signs deal with Fujisawa.

text.p: Belgian chemicals group Solvay SA said on Monday it had signed an agreement with Fujisawa Pharmaceutical Co Ltd for the distribution of Solvay's Luvox drug in Japan.
Solvay said in a statement it would manufacture and package Luvox tablets while Fujisawa will handle distribution and promotion.

Luvox, or Fluvoxamine, is Solvay's best-selling obsessive compulsive disorder drug. It is already marketed in 52 countries and has been prescribed to more than 15 million patients, Solvay said. -- Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6815, Fax +32 2 230 7710
